# Saniya Farooqui

> Full-Stack Developer (MERN Stack, React Native) and Co-Founder of KisanX, based in Mumbai, India. Builds production-ready web and mobile applications using React, Node.js, PHP, MySQL, and MongoDB.

Saniya Farooqui is a Full-Stack Developer and B.Sc. IT student at Mumbai University, based in Virar, Mumbai Metropolitan Region, India. She builds production-ready web and mobile applications end-to-end — database to deployment — using the MERN stack (MongoDB, Express, React, Node.js), PHP/MySQL, and React Native (Expo). She is Co-Founder of KisanX, a full-stack agricultural marketplace presented at the Avishkar Inter-Collegiate Research Convention, Mumbai University. She holds 5 IIT Bombay certifications and has completed Deloitte Technology and Cybersecurity job simulations via Forage. Currently open to internships, entry-level software engineering roles, freelance projects, and collaboration.

## Skills

Frontend: HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript (ES6+), React.js (Hooks, State Management, Component Design).
Backend: PHP/MySQL, Node.js, Express.js, REST APIs, JWT Auth.
Database: MongoDB (Mongoose, Schema Design), MySQL.
Mobile: React Native (Expo).
Tools: Git, GitHub.
Currently learning: Advanced JavaScript, Advanced React (Context API, Performance, Testing), REST API Design, System Design.

## Projects

 [KisanX](https://www.saniya.me/projects/kisanx/): Full-stack Direct-to-Consumer agricultural marketplace connecting Indian farmers directly to buyers. Web app in PHP/MySQL, mobile app in MERN + React Native, JWT auth, deployed on Render. Presented at Avishkar Research Convention, Mumbai University 2024–25. Repos: [web](https://github.com/Saniya1207/kisanX), [backend](https://github.com/Saniya1207/kisanx-backend), [frontend](https://github.com/Saniya1207/kisanx-frontend).
 [The Capital Home Website](https://www.saniya.me/projects/the-capital-home/): Mobile-first real estate landing page built with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, zero dependencies. [Live site](https://anniix.github.io/capital-home/).
 [Vastu Properties Website](https://www.saniya.me/projects/vastu-properties/): React application for a property business with dynamic listing filters. [Live site](https://anniix.github.io/vastuproperties/).
 [Developer Portfolio](https://www.saniya.me/): This site — hand-coded from scratch with custom animations, scroll reveals, and 3D effects, no frameworks.
 [All Projects](https://www.saniya.me/projects/): Full projects listing.
